delivery: next local calendar day; 23/24/25 one-hour intervals
timestamp_convention: interval start ASSUMPTION; upstream hourly aggregation unverified
target: national consumption load_mw; utility portfolio proxy
point_objective: conditional median; primary MAE in MW
holdout_status: chronological holdout previously exposed in EDA; future prospective confirmation required
online_policy: retrain on scheduled origins, using only labels available before fit; no policy changes after test scores
dst_policy: delivery grid in UTC between local midnights; same-wall-hour weekly lag averages both occurrences of a repeated source hour; nonexistent source hour remains missing and triggers fallback
exclusions: missing evaluation targets are unscored and counted
incomplete days excluded only from daily-total and trajectory metrics
peak_policy: retain unusual and genuine peaks; flag for investigation without automatic replacement
